boards.title: Your First Weekend at Pacific Lutheran University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence that combines campus orientation, a meal, activity options, and ways to meet people.

cards.title: Start at the Anderson University Center
cards.subtitle: Campus hub for student life
cards.notes: Begin by walking through the AUC and noting Student Engagement locations. Use the building as a practical reference point before branching out across campus.
cards.short_summary: Use the student-life hub to get oriented.
cards.evidence_claim: PLU lists Student Engagement, Leadership, and Clubs/Organizations in Anderson University Center 161.
cards.source_title: Student Life and Campus Resources | PLU Catalog
cards.access_notes: Check current building access and office availability before visiting.

cards.title: Pause for a Meal at The Commons
cards.subtitle: PLU campus restaurant
cards.notes: Use a meal break to reset and make plans with new classmates. Check the dining page on the day, since service periods and seasonal schedules can change.
cards.short_summary: A simple campus meal stop between activities.
cards.evidence_claim: PLU Dining publishes seasonal service periods and hours for The Commons.
cards.source_title: Campus Restaurants Hours | Dining at PLU
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by season and are subject to change; verify the dining page before going.

cards.title: Make Mortvedt Library Your Study Anchor
cards.subtitle: Campus library
cards.notes: Locate the main desk and pick a floor to remember for future study sessions. Bring your LuteCard, which PLU identifies as the university library card.
cards.short_summary: Find the library before classes make it urgent.
cards.evidence_claim: PLU identifies the LuteCard as a student’s PLU library card; its safety page lists Mortvedt Library locations.
cards.access_notes: Bring a LuteCard; check library services and building access before visiting.

cards.title: Complete the Waiver for Names Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Attached to Memorial Gym
cards.notes: Submit the athletic-facilities waiver before your first workout, then use your LuteCard for entry. Check the calendar for the latest facility schedule.
cards.short_summary: Set up access for a future workout.
cards.evidence_claim: Names Fitness Center is free for current students, requires a liability waiver, and uses LuteCard access.
cards.access_notes: Complete the waiver first and allow one business day for access; hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Walk the PLU Meadows Frisbee Golf Course
cards.subtitle: Recreation course behind Columbia Center
cards.notes: Find the first hole behind Columbia Center, then take a casual walk of the course with friends. Bring a disc if you plan to play rather than only explore.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation option with a defined starting point.
cards.evidence_claim: PLU identifies the PLU Meadows Frisbee Golf Course and places its first hole behind Columbia Center.
cards.access_notes: Course conditions and any scheduled use should be checked locally before play.

cards.title: Register for a Future Outdoor Rec Trip
cards.subtitle: Weekend outings through PLU Recreation
cards.notes: Browse the trip options and register through IMLeagues with your PLU email. Choose an outing that matches your experience, equipment needs, and schedule.
cards.short_summary: Plan a guided outdoor activity for an upcoming weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: PLU Outdoor Recreation states that students can sign up for trips through IMLeagues using a PLU email address.
cards.access_notes: Trip availability, prerequisites, transportation, and any fees vary; review the specific listing before registering.

cards.title: Check What’s On at Eastvold Auditorium
cards.subtitle: Karen Hille Phillips Center for the Performing Arts
cards.notes: Look at the university calendar for a concert, performance, or lecture that fits your weekend. Confirm the event’s ticket policy and start time before making plans.
cards.short_summary: Use the performing-arts calendar to choose an event.
cards.evidence_claim: PLU’s event calendar lists Eastvold Auditorium as a venue for concerts, performances, and other university events.
cards.source_title: Eastvold Auditorium – Karen Hille Phillips Center for the Performing Arts
cards.access_notes: Events and admission terms vary; consult the individual current event listing.

cards.title: Locate the CAVE if You Commute
cards.subtitle: Commuter-student lounge space
cards.notes: If you commute or live off campus, stop by the CAVE to see the lounge and learn about Commuter Advocates. Confirm the current weekday hours first.
cards.short_summary: A designated campus lounge for commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: PLU describes the CAVE as an on-campus community and lounge space for commuter students to rest, study, and eat between classes.
cards.access_notes: The CAVE is hosted on weekdays; its current hours are posted on the CAVE page.

cards.title: Try an African Student Association Meeting
cards.subtitle: DJS Lounge; recurring club meeting
cards.notes: Check the club listing and contact the organization before attending. Its description welcomes students interested in learning about and celebrating African culture.
cards.short_summary: A documented cultural club with a listed recurring meeting.
cards.evidence_claim: PLU’s 2025–2026 club list describes African Student Association and lists meetings every two weeks on Thursday in the DJS Lounge.
cards.access_notes: Meeting details are subject to change; verify with the organization before attending.

cards.title: Set Up Your LuteCard Routine
cards.subtitle: PLU identification and access card
cards.notes: Keep your LuteCard with you while exploring campus. It supports building access assigned to you, campus restaurant purchases, events, library use, and eligible recreation access.
cards.short_summary: Learn the card you’ll use across campus.
cards.evidence_claim: PLU says the LuteCard is the university ID and provides access functions for buildings, campus restaurants, events, library use, and eligible sports facilities.
cards.access_notes: Access levels and event requirements vary by student affiliation and activity.
